summary: This is a Form 6-K furnished by Ardagh Metal Packaging S.A. reporting its first quarter 2026 earnings results. The filing contains a press release with financial highlights: revenue of $1,504 million, Adjusted EBITDA of $179 million, and a loss per share of $0.01. The CEO comments on operational performance, guidance reaffirmation, and a legal verdict in favor of the company. There is no special situation such as a merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return (beyond a regular quarterly dividend), spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or abrupt management change. The dividend is a routine quarterly distribution. Thus, the filing is a routine earnings announcement and not a special situation.
